research_architecture.draw_prediction: Historical-number strategies remain frozen controls unless prospective evidence beats chance after correction.
research_architecture.player_behaviour: Crowd Model estimates how human ticket choices affect sharing risk; it never changes draw probability.
research_architecture.economics: EV Hunter decides whether a draw is economically attractive from prize mechanics, sales demand and collision risk.
research_architecture.integrity: Draw Integrity Auditor tests the random/independent null before any anomaly is treated as potentially meaningful.

data_policy.Lotto: current model uses 6/52 draws from 2026-06-01 onward
data_policy.PowerBall: main model uses 5/50 history; special ball uses current 1-16 era

frozen.name: Frozen Alpha
frozen.policy: These lines never change. A ticket is entered on every eligible draw using the era-correct board cost.

powerball-frequency-reversion-30-v0.1.name: Frequency Reversion 30
powerball-frequency-reversion-30-v0.1.confirmation_note: Prospective only; no result in this sample was available when its shadow line was created.

shadow_research.policy: Prospective research only. Shadow tickets are created only from already-locked challengers before the target result exists.

ev_hunter.purpose: Selective expected-value research based on prize mechanics, sales demand and sharing risk. It changes when to participate, not the probability of the draw.

Daily Lotto.jackpot_role: display_only; Daily Lotto top pool is sales-funded and rolls down rather than rolling over
Daily Lotto.mechanic: 50% of sales funds four pari-mutuel divisions; if Match 5 has no winner its allocation rolls down to Match 4. Jackpot size is therefore not treated as an external rollover asset.

anti_crowd_line.meaning: Ranks equal-probability legal lines for expected sharing risk only. The EV gate gives this line zero predictive or crowd-uplift credit.

Lotto.mechanic: Fixed lower prizes are valued exactly from the current rules; top variable divisions use exact historical pool accounting. The jackpot is valued at the advertised draw amount with collision risk.

anti_crowd_line.meaning: Ranks equal-probability legal lines for expected sharing risk only. The EV gate gives this line zero predictive or crowd-uplift credit.

PowerBall.mechanic: Fixed lower prizes are valued exactly from the current rules; top variable divisions use exact historical pool accounting. The jackpot is valued at the advertised draw amount with collision risk.

anti_crowd_line.meaning: Ranks equal-probability legal lines for expected sharing risk only. The EV gate gives this line zero predictive or crowd-uplift credit.

Daily Lotto.interpretation: Entry decisions use only earlier economics. Historical anti-crowd lines use a fixed literature-informed prior, not the empirical crowd model, preventing future-data leakage.

Lotto.interpretation: Entry decisions use only earlier economics. Historical anti-crowd lines use a fixed literature-informed prior, not the empirical crowd model, preventing future-data leakage.

PowerBall.interpretation: Entry decisions use only earlier economics. Historical anti-crowd lines use a fixed literature-informed prior, not the empirical crowd model, preventing future-data leakage.

methodology.gate: ENTER only when conservative structural expected return >= 1.02x ticket cost. Crowd-model uplift is always zero in the gate.
methodology.daily_lotto: 50% sales-funded pari-mutuel pool with explicit Match-5-to-Match-4 rolldown; no independent rollover jackpot threshold.
methodology.lotto: Current fixed lower prizes are exact rules. The top three divisions use 60/15/25 variable-pool allocations, with the advertised jackpot valued separately as the accumulated top prize.
methodology.powerball: Current fixed lower prizes are exact rules. The top three divisions use 91/6/3 variable-pool allocations, with the advertised jackpot valued separately as the accumulated top prize.
methodology.sales: Rule-era log-demand model with weekday and month-end residual factors. A higher-volume risk estimate is used for conservative prize-sharing calculations.
methodology.crowding: Crowd Model v1 may rank equal-probability lines. No estimated sharing advantage is monetized in the entry decision until prospective evidence supports it.
methodology.historical_test: Historical entries use only earlier economics and a fixed behavioural-prior anti-crowd line, preventing leakage from the empirical crowd model.

crowd_model.purpose: Estimate player-choice crowding from South African ticket sales and winner counts; never used as evidence that a line is more likely to be drawn.

Daily Lotto.target: log(observed prize winners / uniform-choice expected prize winners)
Daily Lotto.interpretation: A positive coefficient means the feature was associated with more prize-winning tickets than uniform player choice would predict. This is player-behaviour research, not draw prediction.

PowerBall.target: log(observed prize winners / uniform-choice expected prize winners)
PowerBall.interpretation: A positive coefficient means the feature was associated with more prize-winning tickets than uniform player choice would predict. This is player-behaviour research, not draw prediction.

crowd_model.use_policy: Empirical crowd scores may rank equal-probability lines for prize-sharing research. No crowding uplift is credited to the EV entry gate until separately confirmed prospectively.

integrity_audit.null_hypothesis: Draws are random and independent within each compatible rule era.

Daily Lotto.interpretation: Passing these tests does not prove perfect randomness; it means this archive does not currently show a corrected anomaly large enough to reject the random/independent null on these predeclared diagnostics.

PowerBall.interpretation: Passing these tests does not prove perfect randomness; it means this archive does not currently show a corrected anomaly large enough to reject the random/independent null on these predeclared diagnostics.

integrity_audit.policy: No integrity result automatically changes live recommendations. Any flagged anomaly requires independent verification, source-quality checks and prospective confirmation.

research.null_hypothesis: Lottery draws are treated as random and independent unless out-of-sample evidence shows otherwise.
research.live_policy: The four dynamic v1.0 strategies plus Frozen Alpha v1.0 remain locked live competitors. Research results do not alter them automatically.
research.feedback_policy: Played-ticket outcomes are used to evaluate models, not as direct number-level features for future recommendations.

Lotto.rule_scope: current 6/52 era from 2026-06-01; legacy 6/58 archived but excluded

PowerBall.rule_scope: 5/50 main-number history spans both eras; current PowerBall pool is 1-16

held_out_test.reason: Research-only challenger. Promotion requires a pre-defined evidence threshold and sufficient out-of-sample samples.
Research-only challenger. Promotion requires a pre-defined evidence threshold and sufficient out-of-sample samples.

notes: All backtests are walk-forward: a target draw is never visible when its prediction is generated.
Hold policies compare refreshing every 1, 2, 4, 8 or 20 draws with a true never-refresh control within a compatible rule era.
ROI is intentionally not used as the primary research score because lottery payout variance can dominate small samples.
Theoretical chance is a research control only; no random tickets are added to the live portfolio.
Evidence labels use hypergeometric match-count variance and Bonferroni correction across the strategy/hold comparisons; challenger validation is corrected across candidate weight profiles.

Rule eras are isolated: legacy Lotto 6/58 is archived but never mixed into the current 6/52 predictor; PowerBall main 5/50 history is compatible across eras while special-ball analysis uses the current 1-16 era.

simulation.frozen_policy: generated once per legal rule era and never changed within that era; reset only when the lottery itself changes the ticket format

principles: Separate draw prediction, player behaviour and prize economics
Live results evaluate models but do not directly reward or punish individual numbers
ROI alone does not establish predictive ability
Respect rule eras and prize-mechanic changes
Exclude questionable data rather than inventing it
